## Description

Downloads the attachments of the Jira issue (manuscript, forms, and so on) into the repository root with `tools/jira_download_attachments.py`, then adds and commits the files that were downloaded. The Jira ticket is read from `config.yml`; when it is not set there, it is looked up from the openICPSR ID and written back to `config.yml`.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/30_download_commit_jira_attachments.sh [--list] [--filter PATTERN]
```

- `--list` - List the attachments; do not download or commit.
- `--filter PATTERN` - Download only files whose names match, for example `manuscript` or `.pdf`.

### Environment Variables

- `JIRA_USERNAME`, `JIRA_API_KEY` - Required.

See [jira_download_attachments.py](#help-jira_download_attachments) for details.
